summary: The single blocking finding is valid and should be applied: docs text parse errors must preview the normalized agent response, not raw subprocess stdout.

items.title: Docs text preview source conflicts with available data path
items.rationale: src/docs/commands/text.js receives the normalized agent response returned by agent.call(), so R4/T-4 must name that response as the preview source. Raw subprocess stdout remains an agent-level diagnostic for R3.
items.evidence: spec.json R4, scope.in, acceptance_criteria, and T-4 currently use stdout/response wording inconsistently; verified code path in src/docs/commands/text.js calls parseBatchJsonResponse(result).
